verdict.rationale: Lindy is a hosted AI-teammate and automation product with routines and skills, so asking about local or dev-instance execution for development and CI testing is a fair question. The evidence pack shows only cloud-hosted routines triggered on schedules or events, plus Slack commands. Nothing documents a local runtime, a dev or staging instance, or CI testing of workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run workflows locally or against a dev instance for development and CI testing
